connector.name: Startup Jobs
connector.registryDescription: Search live startup jobs from Claude, Cursor, or ChatGPT via MCP. Free, no account needed.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.startup.jobs over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the killbridge account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Bearer sj_… API key from https://startup.jobs/account/api_keys for usage attribution and full access. Free tier works without a key. Docs: https://startup.jobs/mcp
